In case of small leakage, flush contaminated area with large amount 
of water 
In case of small leakage, absorb with sand, non-combustible 
material and put it in the container. 
In case of large leakage, make a dich far away from liquid spill. 
Place the spill in a clean, dry container with a clean shovel and 
close loosely, then transfer container from leak area. 
In case of powder leakage, cover with plastic sheet to prevent 
diffusion and keep it dry.

Keep tightly closed.
